title: Barnes Foundation

services.name: Guided Tours
services.desc: Come to the Barnes, or we’ll come to you. Our programs will nourish your students’ imaginations and serve your curricular goals. Learn about the many ways your students can interact with the Barnes from October through June! Guided tours take place Monday-Wednesday at 10 & 11:45 am, and students in grades 8 and up can self-guide, using our self-guiding resources, after their guided tour or during our open hours for more scheduling flexibility. Eligible schools can even request a free multi-touchpoint Partner Program where an educator comes into your classroom!
